description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across different years. The chart contains three slices, representing data from 2019, 2018, and 2017. The largest slice, colored blue, is labeled "2019" and represents 46.0% (46) of the total. A second slice, colored orange, is labeled “2018” and represents 33.0% (33) of the total. The remaining slice, colored green, is labeled "2017" and represents 21.0% (21) of the total. Percentage labels are included inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, from the largest proportion to the smallest. A legend is not present, however the year is included alongside each slice.
